intro: Bottles of a vile green venom fill a Witherbark village in the Hinterlands. So many of them suggest the Witherbarks value it highly, and an apothecary in nearby Tarren Mill might like a sample.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: These bottles hold a vile, green venom.
Considering the number of bottles in this village, the Witherbarks must deem it very important. Perhaps an apothecary in nearby Tarren Mill would like a sample.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, gentle adventurer. The day has been long and not a single experiment successful...I hope you bring good news to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, and what is this? It appears to be venom... From some arachnoid creature I deem. And where did you get it?
